name: card-storyboard-note
from: kit fx/comment-thread, as a full-screen card on kit/CARD_BRIEF.md
does: Dark full-screen card: a real storyboard page as seen on a monitor, close on one beat; its 'Comment on this beat' button takes the hover and presses, a pin with the creator's face drops onto the frame's caption, the note types into a comment and sends, the answer comes back, the old frame dims while the edit works, the new frame lands with its caption grown, and a version badge stamps. Laid out from the capture's own boxes, so any beat of any storyboard page works.
use_when: 'I leave a note on the storyboard and it changes', the storyboard and notes loop; any 'I ask for a change and there it is' beat
what: a real storyboard beat: the note types into its comment box, the answer comes back, the beat updates
inputs: the storyboard to capture and its three beats, the focus beat in the middle (CAPTURE: "" for this project's own storyboard, another project's folder name, or a path to a storyboard index.html); the capture runs a headless browser (heavy)
the focus beat's source frame for the new picture (FRAME: the project, "" for this one, and a time on its output timeline)
the note, the answer, the badge and the new frame's caption (NOTE, REPLY, BADGE, CAPTION) and the beats (T: card seconds or spoken words)
square face crops dropped into img/ and named in HEADSHOT (else a neutral glyph); render the card to cards/<id>.mp4

notes.NOTE: two lines as the comment breaks them; it types from T.type0 to T.type1 across the spoken words
notes.NAME: the commenter's name on the note: the creator's first name reads best
notes.REPLY_NAME: who answers (its avatar is its first letter): the agent that edits
notes.CAPTION: the new frame's caption: words, the lit (spoken) one, size before and after the change (72 and 124 are the kit's lo-fi and huge sizes), its top on the reel
notes.WINDOW: page px: the window shows x0..x1 of the page (cut in the gap after the beat's duration) from `top` above the focus beat, h tall; the default fits the kit's storyboard page
notes.CAPTURE: page: "" = this project's storyboard/index.html, a name = another project folder beside it, or a path; beats: three beat ids (p01...), the focus in the middle
notes.FRAME: the reel (project, "" = this one) and output time the focus beat's frame comes from; its grade at that time is baked in
notes.T: card seconds (0 = the cut to the card); any can be a spoken word (preset.py resolves it); press lands 2 frames before contact

generators.when: the storyboard, the focus beat or its frames change
FRAME changes or that reel's cut or grade changes

needs: render it: the printed command, then cards/{id}.mp4 is picked up by the build (CARDS entry above)
the storyboard it captures must exist (storyboard.py builds this video's)

sfx.name: typing
sfx.what: the note types (placed by its start)
